name: Radios
when: A reader picks one of a few choices, as the neighbors pick the pointer's mode and the heading chart picks the first drone's turn on its rim
replaces: The radio group the neighbors' header built by hand and the radios the heading chart drew into its dial

examples.name: Three Winds
examples.says: The arrow keys move the pick around the group and wrap at either end, and the thumb slides beneath the radio that is on.
